## Private-output composition

Suppose any admitted block module implements K pointwise at every complete
pre-invocation history,for every allowed classical x and actual supplied channel
parameter. Its fresh noise/randomness is private and independent of an untouched
finite reference conditional on X. For rho_XR=sum_x |x><x| tensor rho_R^x,the
output Y,R block is sum_x K_yx rho_R^x by linearity. Noncommuting reference blocks
cause no problem because the module acts only on the classical X/noise side.
Discarding all private proxy records,raw values,degree,count,flags and memory,
and composing the same identity after each controller update proves equality
of the Y record and final reference by induction. Persistence/stationarity and
fresh noise promises must hold at each actual invocation.

A terminal degree drawn independently of X need not be independent of Y. If its
conditional output kernel varies with degree,the joint(Y,degree) differs from
an ideal Y plus an independent count. Thus releasing the count,latency or an
externally correlated proxy-noise reference changes the stated experiment.
No coherent-input measurement,state-changing detector,wall-clock privacy or
nondemolition service is acquired by the cq identity. The earlier exact-count
minimax for fresh-input one-record local modules is not imported as a minimax
claim for delayed blocks or cached persistent inputs. Each actual cheap/raw call,
random-bit/arithmetic cost and source lifetime remains charged.

## One-step construction and completeness

Let U be an m-by-k nonnegative matrix. Put s_z=sum_y U_yz and require

    s_z <= 1,             U L <= K entrywise.                         (1)

Define r_z=1-s_z, D=K-U L and

    q_x = 1-sum_z L_zx s_z = sum_y D_yx.                              (2)

Given z, choose outcome y without a raw read with probability U_yz for each y;
with the remaining probability r_z, request X. If the raw value is x, choose y
with probability D_yx/q_x. Ignore z on this queried branch. If q_x=0, the
queried branch has zero probability for that x; choose its unused rule
arbitrarily. This uses valid distributions because D>=0 and (2) holds.
For each x,y, its total output probability is exactly

    sum_z L_zx U_yz + sum_z L_zx r_z D_yx/q_x
       = (UL)_yx + D_yx = K_yx.                                     (3)

The no-read/query decision is made without knowing X. The code's raw callback
is only invoked on a query branch.

Conversely, fix a private pre-round history of any permitted one-step protocol.
Before its first raw request, it has only Z and X-independent private
randomness. Therefore

    U_yz = Pr[no raw request and output y | record z]

is independent of x. Its columns have mass at most one. The probability of
output y on the no-read branch at input x is (UL)_yx; exactness forces this to
be at most K_yx. Its raw-read probability is exactly (2). Its post-query output
rule can depend on x and z, but (3) replaces it with a rule depending only on x,
without changing either the output channel or raw-read probabilities. Repeated
reads of the same current classical symbol can be cached. Thus (1) describes
all one-step possibilities in the declared resource contract.

Consequently the exact acquisition problem is the rational LP

    minimize q
    U>=0, q>=0,
    sum_y U_yz <= 1                              for each z,
    sum_z U_yz L_zx <= K_yx                      for each y,x,
    1-sum_z L_zx sum_y U_yz <= q                 for each x.          (P)

U=0,q=1 is feasible, so 0<=q*<=1. U is in a compact product of substochastic
simplices; restricting q to [0,1] changes no optimum. A rational optimum exists.

q*=0 exactly when K is a stochastic postprocessing of L. Indeed D>=0 and
zero column masses force D=0. Every record z reachable at some x then has
s_z=1; unused z columns can be completed arbitrarily to a stochastic matrix.

## Source and task contract

The source pin is `e1e2272165c8548326c31bb11817c28f871d21e9`. Its current catalog
contains 1762 records. N1073's complete governing `PROOF.md` (14519 bytes,
SHA256 `33007e1215fd91118e35be36b07b50ea3096b936b3c33c8e519b058d50ad4eb9`)
and completed `SEQUENTIAL_REVIEW.md` were read and retained unchanged. Exact
source routes/hashes are in `SOURCE_MANIFEST.json`. A packet is navigation;
this extension relies on the governing proof, not its card's authority alone.

N1073 assumes finite rational column-stochastic K,L; an already-classical X;
one fresh private Z~L(.|X); and an optional charged raw-X disclosure. It
characterizes a substochastic no-read U with UL<=K and the known queried
residual. Its adaptive result preserves the controller's Y record and finite
cq reference. Z, raw values, flags, costs, private randomness and memory remain
private. It neither manufactures a coherent-input measurement nor acquires a
physical source/calibration.

The new task holds one classical X persistent while the module gets several
fresh iid cheap records and delays one K output. All cheap service calls,
preparation, reset, calibration, entropy, arithmetic, storage and latency are
charged. The persistent iid stream is a supplied resource, equally available
to ordinary methods. Initial private randomness is independent of current X;
no free cached raw X, true-channel descriptor or parameter side channel is
supplied. A raw callback discloses X only.

Output equality below means equality of Y, or Y with an untouched cq reference,
after private registers are discarded. It does not preserve the joint law of
(Y,Z,flags,count). Even a call count independent of X can reveal information
when combined with Y, because the conditional output law can depend on count.
